notes.title: Korean translation
notes.content: Special thanks to Yuri Nyang, a dedicated fan of the game! keyg: the last prison is now available in Korean!

notes.title: 20 new Extra Puzzles
notes.content:
[b]keyg: the last prison[/b] has received a thrilling update, featuring 20 brand new and captivating puzzles. These exciting challenges are now available for free through the menu. Simply select "puzzles" and get ready to embark on a mind-bending adventure like never before!

I extend mine heartfelt gratitude to all those who have been part of this incredible journey throughout the years. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. Cheers to all!

notes.title: Spanish translation
notes.content: Thanks to the wonderful Emiliano Domenech keyg is now available in Spanish!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.1 of keyg is released![/b]

Here what it includes:

[list]
[*] Lots of bug fixes. Probably some are still there, so don't be shy, tell me about them.
[*] Lots of level corrections. Some were too difficult, some too confusing. Now I hope it's fine.
[*] 1 new level that I think is necessary.
[*] Something else that I forgot about.
[/list]

To celebrate the new patch keyg is on sale for 1 week!

Thanks to everyone who played and will be playing my game! Love ya all.
